category_title: Struggling students who rely on step-by-step guided instruction and manipulatives
scenario_title: After-school math tutoring with formulas and homework
minimal_context: The student is working one-on-one on math homework involving formulas during an after-school tutoring session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started on your math homework. We have a full hour to work on these formula problems.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t like staying but I know I can get good help—Ms. Haley really does class differently after school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and try the first formula problem on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I really struggle with these. If I have to take this homework home to finish, it usually won't come back the next day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the formula on the page and see what you can do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it just looking at the formula. I need you to go over the problems step-by-step, or show me the manipulatives so I can see how they relate to my notes.

task.learning_goal: To progress through the work and see how manipulatives relate to the formulas or his notes

context.materials: Homework, class notes, physical manipulatives, whiteboard

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When dealing with math homework and abstract formulas without support
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Really struggles; expresses dislike for staying after school
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Reluctance to stay but acknowledges the need for help

behavior_patterns.condition: If he had to take his homework home
